basic_profile.bio: Aviation enthusiast and tattoo aficionado living in the Pacific Northwest. I have a keen interest in primitive tattooing techniques and spend my free time exploring true crime mysteries. I work as a commercial pilot, which keeps me airborne most of the week. When not flying, I enjoy hiking and spending time with my rescue dog. Typically active on Reddit in the evenings, particularly after 9 PM PST. Currently single and enjoy traveling to new destinations whenever possible.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in aviation, having graduated from an aviation academy and worked as a commercial pilot for over a decade. My interest in tattoos began as a hobby, and I've learned about tattooing techniques through online research and community discussions. Additionally, I follow true crime cases closely, often engaging in discussions about unsolved mysteries.
